title: The Tally: leaderboards for nearly everything
lines: A new post between the Grove and the quest board, and on the dock: boards of who has done the most, for this week and for all time.
Tap anybody on a board to see their card.

more.head: The guild
points: Guild raids, and each of the five raids. Wars, and defences: wars over a territory in Sequoia's claim.
Season rating, quests finished, Leaf earned (spending does not lower it), SEQ level and milestones.

more.head: The Works and The Little Raid
points: Top yards, highest tier, orders handed over and time in the Works.
Runs won, rooms fought, bosses beaten and time at the table.

more.head: The town
points: Time in town and camp, and dozing: time there AFK.
Crab No. 7 spotted, callers greeted at your camp, camps visited and visitors to your camp. A visit counts after 30 seconds.
Waves, things tapped, logs on the fire and roll calls. One wave counts every 30 seconds, a tap or a log every 5, a roll call every 10.

more.head: How a board works
points: The top 3 stand on the podium and places 4 to 10 are under it. Your own place is at the foot when you are not in the top 10.
A tie shares a place. A week starts on Monday at 00:00 UTC, as weekly quests do.
Nothing on a board can be bought with Leaf or Coins.
